create_JepaConfig: create a JepaConfig dataclass instance with default base JEPA model architecture settings
create_JepaEncoderConfig: create a JepaEncoderConfig dataclass to configure Vision Transformer encoder dimensions and attention heads
register_jepa_configs: register JEPA model architecture configs like tiny, small, base, large, huge, giant, and gigantic into a DependencyContainer
customize_JepaEncoderConfig_model_dim: customize the JepaEncoderConfig model_dim to set the dimensionality of the JEPA model
customize_JepaEncoderConfig_patch_dims: customize the JepaEncoderConfig patch_dims to configure patch extraction dimensions for image or video inputs
